test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Directions: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in the reported speech.**

Harsh said, “How happy I am to receive the best student award!”

options.text: Harsh exclaimed with joy that he was very happy to receive the best student award.
Harsh exclaimed happily that he was receiving the best student award.
Harsh exclaimed with joy that how happy he was to receive the best student award.
Harsh exclaimed happily that I am very happy to receive the best student award.

solution:
The correct answer is **Harsh exclaimed with joy that he was very happy to receive the best student award**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is a direct speech.
 
• The basic rules for changing or converting direct speech into indirect speech:​
 
 
• The **given sentence** is **an exclamatory sentence**.
 
• The exclamation mark (!) is removed, 'that' is added and the full stop (.) is added in place of the exclamation mark.
 
• **Exclamatory sentences express a sudden outburst of some emotions such as joy, sorrow, contempt, regret, surprise, etc**.
 
• **In indirect speech, the exclamatory phrase or word (interjection) is replaced by ‘exclaimed with joy, sorrow, regret, surprise, contempt, etc.’**
 
• The first-person pronoun ''I'' becomes the third-person pronoun ''he''.
 
• The present simple tense format 'Subject + V1 (am) + Object' will be changed into the past simple tense format 'Subject + V2 (was) + Object'.
 
• From the given options the only suitable answer is option 1.

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**

__
 
• You may think that the fourth option should be the correct option but in the option, the first person pronoun remains unchanged. 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is option 1.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The following table will enable us to know how tense changes into Indirect speech:-

 Indirect Speech

 Past simple (Subject +V2 + Object)
 
 

 Present continuous (Subject +is/am/are+V1 +ing+ Object)
 Past Continuous (Subject +was/were+V1 +ing+ Object)
 
 

 Present perfect (Subject + has/have+V3+Object)
 Past perfect (Subject+had+V3+Object)
 
 

 Past simple (Subject+V2+Object)
 Past perfect (Subject+had+V3+Object)
 
 

 Past Continuous (Subject +was/were+V1+ing+ Object)

 Future simple (Subject+ will/shall+V1+object)
 Present Conditional (Subject+would+V1+object)
